'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Brodsky DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
